tex_content.html: \begin{example} \end{example}[Linearization of the map-Laplacian (Exercise K.16)] 1. appk:K.16\group Harmonic Maps Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0364 ↗ lem:chow-iv-k15-second-variation For the variation map $F(x,s)=f_s(x)$ and $V=\partial _sF|_{s=0}$, prove \[ \nabla _{\partial /\partial s}(\Delta _{g,h}^{\mathcal M}F) =\Delta _{g,h}V+\operatorname {tr}_g(R^N(V,df)df). \] \end{example}
